steps.text: Hey 😊 Did your grand expedition away from the sofa happen, or did the console win?
I made it to the kitchen and back several times
An experienced traveler
There was also a little time outside
Then I sat down before I started regretting my ambition
That actually sounds sensible
You sound surprised
I'm trying not to ruin the moment
How was the rest of your day?
We finished our part of the project, so I can finally stop thinking about it
Then I got home, made dinner, and realized I'd cooked enough pasta for a family of six
That's tomorrow sorted
And possibly the rest of my life
You could bring some next time
Look at you solving my problems
Wait, let me get comfortable before you distract me again
5 MINUTES LATER
There. Hair still damp, but I'm not moving again
You look like you're about to fall asleep
I'm not. I've only just sat down
That's usually how it starts
Very funny
There is something I wanted to check before tomorrow, actually
Go ahead
The other night, when I asked what you'd want to know if I sent a picture to someone else
I remember your answer. I just don't want to assume it covers everything we might do
That's fair
You said you'd want to know, and receive the picture too
Yeah. I like the idea of being included in what you choose to share
Okay. But if I'm out talking to someone, I won't necessarily be looking at my phone the whole time
I'm not asking you to give me updates every five minutes
I'd like to see the picture if that's something you decide to share. A conversation is different
Good. I don't want you waiting for a message and thinking something's wrong because I'm not typing
Tell me when you're free, then we can actually talk
I like that better
And don't get too excited about the pictures yet. I haven't even had the first conversation 😌
I'm being very patient
You're doing a convincing impression of it
You said you'd want to know, but wouldn't necessarily want the picture yourself
Yeah. That still fits
I want to hear about it from you. I don't need you collecting things to show me
That's a relief, honestly
I'd rather tell you how something felt than worry about proving it happened
I'm not checking your homework
Good. I've had enough of that today
And if you're busy, we can talk afterward
Okay. I'll tell you when I've got a moment, rather than trying to keep up a second conversation on my phone
Exactly
You still get my ordinary pictures, by the way. You're not escaping my face that easily 😌
I wasn't planning to
You said you might not want to know
Did you mean not knowing about each individual thing, or not having updates while it's happening?
I hadn't really separated those in my head
That's why I'm asking
I can understand leaving room for a surprise. I just don't want us to mean two different things without realizing

options.text: Let's agree on the limits, but leave some things as a surprise
I'd rather have no updates during it, then talk afterward

steps.text: I'd rather agree on what we're trying first, then leave room for you not to tell me about every little thing
Okay. A surprise within what we've actually talked about, not me guessing how far that answer goes
Exactly
For now, we're only talking about making contact and seeing whether a first date feels right
I know. I'm not treating this like we've already agreed to everything else
And if something feels wrong, I'm telling you. I'm not keeping that to myself to preserve the mystery
Of course. Same for me
All right. That makes more sense to me now
I think I'd rather not follow everything while it's happening
But afterward, I would like to hear how it went and how you felt
So I put my phone away, have the conversation, and we talk when I'm free
Yeah. That sounds closer to what I meant
Okay. I can do that
And if I need to talk to you sooner, I'm still going to
Obviously. You don't have to stick to some plan when you need me
Good ❤️
I'm glad we talked about that now
I kept imagining myself looking at my phone, wondering whether I was supposed to be sending you something
I don't want you worrying about that
I know. It's easier now we've actually said it
So what do you want to do tomorrow?
I'll ask {{name:aiden}} if we can talk for a few minutes after class
I want to explain that we've been discussing the idea of me going on a date with someone else
And that he's someone I'd consider having that conversation with
You think he'll believe you're serious?
Probably not immediately
That's partly why I want to talk face to face. I can tell him to stop making jokes if I need to
Please don't tell him how quickly I said his name
You mean immediately?
That sounds worse when you say it
I can leave that detail out 😌
I'm not going to show him our messages either. I can explain the situation myself
Thank you
Then we'll see how he feels. I'm not inviting him anywhere before we've even managed that conversation
Let me know how you're doing when you get a chance
I will ❤️
I wrote a short introduction earlier. Want to read it?
Send it
I'm in a relationship, and my partner knows I'm here. I'd like to get to know someone, starting with a conversation and maybe a coffee
That says what you mean
It doesn't sound too formal?
A little. Add something about yourself that isn't about us
Like my impressive ability to cook six portions of pasta by accident?
Honestly, yes
I like quiet cafés, terrible films, and apparently cooking for people who don't exist
That sounds much more like you
You're included in the pasta, don't worry 😌
Wait, I want to try taking one now while the light's nice
I'll try to give you a completely unbiased opinion
That would be a first
2 MINUTES LATER
Okay, this one actually looks like me
That's the expression I get when you tell me you've only stolen one fry
I look innocent because I am
The photo is excellent. The legal defense needs work
I'm keeping the photo then 😌
I'll use that one and read the introduction again tomorrow before I put anything up
Then I can see if there's someone I actually want to talk to
And you don't owe anyone a conversation just because they message you
I know. I'm curious, not accepting applications from the entire internet
Now that's a good profile title
You're not helping anymore
I'm nervous about tomorrow
But I like that it's a small thing I actually want to do, rather than some huge leap I'm trying to be ready for
You can tell me if it turns out to feel different than you expected
You too
I don't want you pretending you're fine just because you were the one who brought it up
I won't
Okay ❤️
Now, very important question
I'm listening
When I bring you pasta, are we watching something decent, or are you making me watch another film where nobody turns a light on?
That's atmosphere
That's two hours of me asking who's standing in the doorway
You can pick this time
Really?
Yes. But I reserve the right to complain
I'd be worried if you didn't
I want that afternoon with you, you know
Not to have another serious discussion. Just to eat too much and sit next to you for a while
I want that too
Then don't forget. I'm still claiming my spot on the sofa
It's yours
Hang on, I'm moving from the sofa to bed before I fall asleep here
5 MINUTES LATER
There. I'm saving you the other pillow
You're really not helping with how much I miss you
Then come and claim it when you can
I will ❤️
Good night, handsome ❤️
Good night. Save me some pasta
There is enough pasta to outlive both of us. Go to sleep 😭
